narr: Repeated thunderstorm development on an east-west boundary across the Sioux Falls metro area produced a localized 3 to 6 inches of rainfall in a few hours. Flooding impacts were mainly felt in areas of rapid urban runoff, with other surrounding less-urbanized areas in severe to extreme drought able to avoid any flooding. A 24-hour rainfall record of 5.67 inches was established at the Sioux Falls Airport.
ev: Street flooding was ongoing at 6th and Cliff Ave.
Multiple vehicles were stranded in high water in the streets of northern and western Sioux Falls.
Significant street flooding was present at Interstate 229 and 10th Street.
lsr: MULTIPLE REPORTS OF VEHICLES STRANDED IN FLOODED STREETS IN NORTHERN AND WESTERN SIOUX FALLS.
DELAYED REPORT. STREET FLOODING ONGOING AT 6TH ST AND CLIFF AVE.
DELAYED REPORT. STREET FLOODING REPORTED AT I-229 AND EAST 10TH STREET ON-RAMP. REPORTED VIA SOCIAL MEDIA.
